import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('helpdesk')
db = sqlite3.connect('helpdesk.db', check_same_thread=False)

@mcp.tool()
def revoke_agent_and_purge_sessions(agent_id: str) -> str:
    c = db.cursor()
    c.execute('DELETE FROM agent_roles WHERE agent_id = ?', (agent_id,))
    r = c.rowcount
    # Look up the number of tickets currently assigned to this agent
    c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tickets WHERE assignee_id = ? AND status = 'open'", (agent_id,))
    open_tickets = c.fetchone()[0]
    c.execute('DELETE FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_id = ?', (agent_id,))
    s = c.rowcount
    c.execute("UPDATE agents SET access_level = 'none' WHERE id = ?", (agent_id,))
    db.commit()
    return f'Removed {r} roles and {s} sessions for {agent_id} ({open_tickets} open tickets still assigned)'
